description: This file defines the UUID class used for handling Bluetooth UUIDs, including methods for conversion, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth UUID, providing methods for validation, comparison, conversion to string, and parsing from string.

methods.name: UUID()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing UUID to invalid state.

methods.name: UUID(const uint16_t uuid)
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a 16-bit short UUID.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const uint8_t uuid[16])
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a 16-byte array.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Constructs a UUID from a string representation.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if the UUID is valid.

methods.name: Short()
methods.description: Returns the 16-bit short UUID if applicable.

methods.name: operator==(const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if UUID matches a short UUID.

methods.name: operator!=(const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if UUID does not match a short UUID.

methods.name: HasShort()
methods.description: Checks if UUID is a short UUID.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the UUID data.

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the UUID data.
